data.one_liner: Animated bottom navigation bar with customizable icons, colors, and badge support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BottomNavigationBar where icons animate into place when selected. Supports optional badges, RTL layouts, and programmatic tab changes via a controller.
use_when: You need a custom animated bottom navigation bar beyond the default Flutter widget
You want built‑in badge support and RTL compatibility
You prefer a controller to change tabs programmatically
avoid_when: You only need a simple static navigation bar without animation
You require deep linking or nested navigation handling
You need a navigation solution that integrates with routing packages
strengths: Badge support out of the box
weaknesses: No built‑in routing or deep‑link handling
Customization beyond provided properties may require source edits
data.minimal_example:
```dart
MotionTabBar(
  controller: _motionTabBarController,
  initialSelectedTab: "Home",
  labels: const ["Dashboard", "Home", "Profile", "Settings"],
  icons: const [Icons.dashboard, Icons.home, Icons.people_alt, Icons.settings],
  onTabItemSelected: (int i) => setState(() => _motionTabBarController!.index = i),
);
```
